zeroshot.text:
Canonical hold for all downstream enclosure work — **portrait stick, component face toward the user, USB edge at the bottom**: long axis (v, 51.0 mm) vertical, width axis (u, 21.0 mm) horizontal; board-local (u,v) = KiCad (X−x0, Y−y0), KiCad Y grows toward v-max [citation: easyduino-pico-enclosure/analysis/pcb_geometry.json coordinate_note + outline].
- **Bottom end (functional anchor) = the v=0 edge:** hosts J1, the only edge-mating connector — shell span u 5.86–15.5 (center u=10.68), body v 1.4–7.72, mouth ~1.4 mm in from the board edge; cable inserts horizontally, plug axis parallel to v, from outside the bottom wall [citation: easyduino-pico-enclosure/analysis/component_geometry.json J1; board_context README excerpt "micro-USB at the v=0 edge" echoed in easyduino-pico-enclosure/README.md]. NOTE: family predecessors placed USB at v-max — this board's mating wall is v=0; the *rule* ("USB edge = anchor") transfers, the family coordinate does not [citation: easyduino-pico-enclosure/stages/02-orient.json (family precedent, and itself wrong for this board); enclosure-forge/references/lessons.md L6].
- **Doc conflict, resolved:** README/docs say "micro-B"; the extracted footprint is U
